## Checklist

- [ ] Branch was created from `main`
- [ ] Method was created from a copy of `Template.med`
- [ ] Method name follows the [naming convention](https://github.com/tobiajenifuja/SangerCleanup/wiki/Creating-a-New-Method/) (no versions, dates, author names, "Cleanup" or "XP")
- [ ] Method is in its own workflow folder
- [ ] Method has been tested on the instrument
- [ ] Commit messages clearly describe the changes
